scope: Complete NBA-only franchise championships, conference championships and major award winners through 2025–26. Franchise attribution follows NBA team continuity and historical team names. For franchises that entered from the ABA, records begin with their 1976–77 NBA seasons; no ABA titles, awards, seasons or statistics are included. NBA.com's official historical league record includes BAA-era seasons beginning in 1946–47.
